correctness.rationale: For B_1^d and any nonzero ray v, sign changes reduce to v>=0. Midpoint coordinates partition the overlap into coordinates inside/outside their separation intervals; outside orthants integrate to (U-|sum(z)-a|)_+^k/k!. The truncated-power identity and exact inclusion-exclusion for box moments make the outer two terms cancel after summing every sign/subset pattern. Remaining terms are products t^(d-k+r)*(1-Lt/2)^(k-r) with direction-only positive-part coefficients, hence a single polynomial of degree <=d on [0,2/L]; empty intersection after endpoint. Continuity covers zero coordinates; simple linear endpoint slope is claimed ONLY for all v_i>0 and d>=2. Independently evaluated geometric convex hull volumes via SciPy HalfspaceIntersection for v=(1,1), (1,1,1), (1,2,3) at three interior separations each and matched explicit polynomials to <1e-9; finite geometric checks corroborate the algebraic proof.
residual_risks: The inclusion-exclusion cancellation is the key nonstandard symbolic lemma; detailed finite checks do not prove its general all-subset cancellation.

value.rationale: The l1 ball is a canonical high-dimensional convex body and its directional autocorrelation is a natural integral-geometric invariant. A nonobvious cancellation of every interior knot gives an exact polynomial for ALL rays, not merely isolated axis formulas; useful for explicit overlap geometry, Fourier analysis and exact integration. The scope distinguishes one ray-wise polynomial from a globally multivariate polynomial, and it states the sharp endpoint slope with necessary positivity assumptions.
residual_risks: Potential prior generic parametric-integration simplification; exponential explicit formula is a computational limitation, not loss of structural value.
